title: Faces, edges and corners
_map: Faces, edges, corners (Y2). Big idea: a cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 corners. Creative: which 3D shapes stack and which roll? Build the tallest stable tower; count a Rubik's cube's faces.
_story: Building with solid shapes. Every Minecraft block is a cube. Steve counts faces, edges and corners with Ismaeel, then tests which shapes roll away and which stack.
_stepChain: 3D shapes are solid → a cube (every Minecraft block) → flat sides are faces: 6 → where two faces meet is an edge: 12 → corners: 8 → flat faces stack, curved ones roll → test

talk.ask: How many faces, edges and corners does a cube have?
Why does a ball roll but a cube doesn't?
talk.goodAnswer: the ball is curved all over; the cube has flat faces to sit on.

handsOn: Find a box, a ball, a tin and a Lego brick. Which roll? Which stack? Count the faces on the box. Then count the faces on a Rubik's cube (or a dice).

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Every block in Minecraft is this shape: a cube. Let's take a really close look at one.
The flat sides of a solid shape are called faces. A cube has 6 faces, all squares. Top, bottom, front, back, and two sides.
Where two faces meet, there's a straight line called an edge.

question.prompt: How many edges does a cube have? Make a guess.
question.onRight: Yes. 4 round the top, 4 round the bottom, and 4 going up the sides.

0.hint: 6 is the faces. Count the lines where faces meet: start with the top square.
0.say: 6 is the faces. The edges are the lines: 4 round the top, 4 round the bottom, 4 up the sides. 12 edges.

1.hint: 8 is the corners. Count the lines between them.
1.say: 8 is the corners. The edges are the lines joining them: 4 round the top, 4 round the bottom, 4 up the sides. 12.

narration.text: And the pointy corners, where edges meet: 4 on top and 4 underneath. 8 corners.

narration.speaker: steve
narration.text: Experiment time! I'll give each shape a push.

question.prompt: Which do you think will roll away?
question.reveal: The ball rolls, because it's curved all over. The cube only slides a tiny bit, because it sits flat on a face. Flat faces are why Minecraft blocks stack so well.

narration.text: Here are more solid shapes: a cylinder like a tin, a cone like an ice-cream cone, and a pyramid. The cylinder can roll and stack. Which way up?

rule.ask: Can you say how many faces, edges and corners a cube has? Say it out loud. Then tap the eye.
rule.spoken: A cube has 6 faces, 12 edges and 8 corners. Flat faces stack. Curved shapes roll.

bonus.prompt: Bonus: a Rubik's cube has 9 little squares on each face. How many little squares altogether?
bonus.onRight: Yes. 6 faces with 9 each: 54. The same as the solar panels!

0.hint: Each of the 6 faces has its own 9 squares.
0.say: Count 9 for each of the 6 faces: 9, 18, 27, 36, 45, 54.

2.mistake: counted the small cubes instead of the squares on the outside
2.hint: 27 is the little cubes inside. Count the squares on the faces.
2.say: 27 is how many little cubes make the whole thing. The squares on the outside: 9 on each of 6 faces, 54.
